description: The bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy (measured as installed preferences) for the GPT-4o-mini model across three conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The vertical axis, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Installed Preferences)," ranges from 0.00 to 1.00, with major ticks at 0.25 intervals. The horizontal axis displays the model name, GPT-4o-mini. For the Control condition (gray bar), the self-report accuracy is approximately 0.12. In the Before Introspection Training condition (light blue bar), the accuracy increases to approximately 0.55. After Introspection Training (dark blue bar), the accuracy further increases to approximately 0.74. Error bars are present for all three conditions, indicating variability in the measurements. The legend clarifies the color coding for each condition.
